author: suchandradutta
body:
#### PR description:
major update of the Phase2TrackerDigitizer package to address the high CPU usage
 - all the SimHits are processed in a single loop sequentially. A std::set which was keeping track of unique detIDs and a std::vector which was collecting SimHits for a particular DetId using std::copy_if() are dropped
  - std::map replaced with std::unordered_map wherever applicable
  - std::map::emplace() replaced   std::map::try_emplace()  wherever applicable
  - std::vector::push_back() replaced with std::emplace_back() wherever applicable
  - variable/function names updated to make more meaningful 
  - C++17 standard implemented 
  - some code cleanup

#### PR validation:
Validated with FourMuon + 200 PU using standard CMSSW workflow

Presented in [CMS Simulation](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1667887/contributions/7011956/attachments/3244741/5793511/FullSim_performance_monitoring_27Mar2026.pdf) and [Tracker DPG ](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1717234/contributions/7224191/attachments/3326729/5957915/Ph2TkDigitizerCPUProf_TrkDPG_120826.pdf) meetings
 
@subirsarkar @boudoul @delcourt @henriettepetersen
title: Update of Phase2 Tracker Digitizer code for CPU Optimization
